sentences.en: Under the circumstances we have no choice but to surrender.
sentences.zh: 在目前的情况下，我们别无选择只能投降。

sentences.en: Completely surrounded by our troops, the enemy finally surrendered to us.
sentences.zh: 被我们的部队完全包围后，敌人最终向我们投降了。

sentences.en: He held up his hands in token of surrender.
sentences.zh: 他举起双手作为投降的象征。
